title: Tree Shaking
definition: Tree shaking is a dead-code elimination step performed by bundlers like Webpack or Vite. It statically analyzes ES Modules (`import`/`export`) and entirely removes unused code from the final bundle.
simpleExplanation: If you import a giant math library but only use the `add()` function, tree shaking deletes all the other unused functions so they don't bloat your app.
